name: open-hangar
description: The free Star Citizen fleet manager's browser extension: reads your own RSI account in your browser, with optional sync to openhangar.space.

scripts.test: node --test test/parser.test.js test/scan.test.js test/htf.test.js test/value.test.js test/log.test.js test/profiles.test.js test/sanitize.test.js test/catalog.test.js test/org.test.js test/updates.test.js test/source.test.js test/qr.test.js test/referral.test.js test/resilience.test.js test/loaners.test.js test/store.test.js test/home.test.js test/status.test.js test/net.test.js test/buyback-details.test.js test/buyback-history.test.js test/buyback-names.test.js test/db.test.js test/publish.test.js test/rates.test.js test/quips.test.js test/scan-report.test.js test/known-issues.test.js test/retired-buybacks.test.js test/full-size.test.js test/site-connect.test.js test/ui-css-links.test.js test/firefox-data.test.js test/site-sync.test.js test/esc-filters.test.js test/archive-export.test.js test/rsi-cart.test.js test/storage-budget.test.js test/site-import.test.js test/buyback-block.test.js test/beta-build.test.js test/quick-links.test.js test/sub-store.test.js test/home-final.test.js test/feeds.test.js test/build-flags.test.js test/privacy-permissions.test.js
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.pack: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist --filename open-hangar-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --filename open-hangar-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.build:beta: npm run build:ui && node scripts/pack.mjs --beta && web-ext build --source-dir dist/beta --artifacts-dir dist --filename open-hangar-beta-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/beta-firefox --artifacts-dir dist --filename open-hangar-beta-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && node scripts/check-store-build.mjs --beta
scripts.lint:firefox-beta: npm run build:beta && web-ext lint --self-hosted --source-dir dist/beta-firefox
